observation_type: Future unseen dates with preopen fixed-panel eligibility seals and post-close retrospective SIP bars; not real-time as-received or fill validation.

selection.panel: fixed6633plusforcedSPYQQQ, no new symbols promoted during version
selection.prior_history: exactly20 immediately preceding registered calendar sessions
selection.etf_unknown: retain tagged unknown; explicit Y excluded from stocks; controls never stock
selection.source_completeness: All fixed-panel symbol requests and every pagination chain must finish before selection; omitted price history is a stock-level reason only if the request itself completed. No partial-pool ranking.
selection.numeric_safety: Decimal encoding coefficient at most80digits and absolute exponent at most100; values outside these parser-safety limits are invalid prior20 inputs, not additional financial price thresholds.

timing.daily_input: Same-session capture of prior sessions only, SIP/raw/1Day; last input date strictly before target date. Source requested_at and received_at both recorded.
timing.primary_source_version: First bundle in window with all required requests/pages completed, irrespective of individual missing/invalid bars or holding-window availability. Freeze that version even with unknown outcomes; later revisions separate, never wait for a more profitable or gap-free version.
timing.timestamps: Executor receipt logs, not cryptographically authenticated historical delivery proofs; bar event_time alone cannot establish live availability.
timing.offline_review: Verification/analysis/review may happen after receipt_deadline provided original preopen seal and source requested_at/received_at met their windows. Running late cannot fabricate an earlier seal/receipt.

market_classification.definition: Complete0..29 stock prefix earliest min-close t_min; benchmark close at same t_min/open0-1 <= -0.005 inclusive => market_down, otherwise market_not_down; any invalid/incomplete prefix unknown.

feature_bins.information_time: All first30 bars end10:00ET; with postclose sources this is an event-time descriptor, not proof of live receipt.
feature_bins.definitions: gap=open0/sealed_prior_close-1; close29=close[29]/open0-1; trough=earliest integer0..29 attaining minimum first30 close. Complete unique valid first30 required; absent prior_close makes only gap unknown. Use exact raw-price cross-products for <=-0.02,(-0.02,0),>=0, and integer trough0..9/10..19/20..29. No display-rounded boundaries.

outcomes.primary_endpoint: At final calendar endpoint: arithmetic mean of per-date complete SPYdown primary target net stock-proxy returns; nonempty dates equally weighted. Empty dates not zeros.
outcomes.evidence_label_scope: Operational sample-size label only, not independent-date proof, power calculation or significance threshold. Fewer dates = insufficient sample, never replace the fixed end date.
outcomes.interval: Final-only descriptive95% percentile bootstrap of complete date means,2000 whole-date draws, deterministic SHA256 first16hex seed s500_prospective_flush_fixed_panel_v1|primary_final, linear interpolation. n<2 no interval. Serial dependence and finite-date coverage remain; interval alone does not validate options or strategy.
outcomes.checkpoints: 20/40 report counts/missingness/all fixed-bin point estimates without new intervals or tuning. Calendar reviews do not wait for profitable signals.
outcomes.peers: Only among same-date sealed selected stock_eligible cases, excluding target and SPY/QQQ: complete valid first30 prefix not reaching the SAME 2% or3% threshold; rank absolute log prior liquidity distance then symbol, choose3 before checking future returns, never replace missing peers.
outcomes.multiplicity: One declared final primary endpoint; all other slices descriptive and cannot be selected as a validation winner.
outcomes.costs: Preserve5/10/25bp per side; already net returns are not charged twice; no option cost substitution.

missing_and_revisions.calendar: Every planned date stays in ledger, even no run/no signal/unknown. Calendar changed/closure recorded as append-only operational deviation; no substitute dates.
missing_and_revisions.preopen_missed: No primary eligible selection for this date; do not reconstruct preopen seals after observing returns.
missing_and_revisions.postclose_missed_or_failed: Preserve sealed cases with unknown outcomes and source failure reason. Do not fill zero, rerank or replace.
missing_and_revisions.no_signal: Distinct from missing observations; an observed no-flush or no-rebound is not a zero-return trade.
missing_and_revisions.late_data: Record first-seen time and supersedes links in separate amended ledger; no retrospective promotion to primary.
missing_and_revisions.early_stop: No performance-based shortening/extension. Technical outages may pause acquisition, not erase failed dates.

limitations: Frozen directory cohort excludes future listings and retains known historical survivorship and symbol-identity problems.
Retrospective postclose SIP values may be revised and do not reconstruct what an intraday agent received.
Future primary outcome dates can be scarce or correlated.
Source outages and complete-window conditioning remain selection limitations.
Actual option contracts, bidask, whole-contract affordability and execution are unverified.
